main_text.p: Α᾽λλ᾽ ἐν ᾗ νῦν Πεί᾽εδ᾽. ἀμφὶ δ᾽ ἀμμιν ἀντίῳ ἐν πολέμῳ ἐσὴν Δαιμόνιοι, πὴ μάχης ἱμείςετ. Theocr. Διο-σκυρ.At, at, citius Romam nouam crearit Deus, quàm reformàrit veterem : Imo necesse est se prorsus exuat Ecclesia illa, retexatque ; quæque modo est esse desinat, priùs, quàm vt quæ olim fuit, esse nunc denuò incipiat:

p.i: Simul enim res, fides, fama, virtus
Facta est nimio nequior : nec videor mihi
Sarciri posse ædes hasce, quin tota Perpetuæ ruant, quin cum fundamento

page.notes: Greek verse above the text is partly blurred; readings of the Greek line are doubtful. Right margin notes: "Theocr. Διοσκυρ." and "Plaut. Mostell." (the Plautus reference is in italics). Foot catchword "Perierint," is at the right of the bottom line.
